terms.grammar: phrase: index, indicis m., with the genitive of fūmus
terms.comment: Our description; no reference work has a word for a smoke alarm. Classically index is one who, or that which, points out or tells (Lewis & Short). The alarm clock is suscitābulum.

phrases.english: The smoke alarm’s going off; open the window!

sources: Lewis & Short: index · Lewis & Short: fumus
The example sentence marked “composed” is ours.
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency (printed page numbers): p. 315.
